data.message: All other 24 fishers: opt in individually to 18 tons; I commit to 18, even if others choose 10. Each switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, but recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains are uncertain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. State your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
